title: 🪨 Asteroid 2013 GM3 — Close Earth Flyby
description:
Asteroid 2013 GM3 makes its closest approach to Earth, passing at 0.7 lunar distances (260,528 km). For reference, the Moon is 1 lunar distance away — this asteroid will pass 0.7× farther than the Moon. There is no impact risk.

The asteroid has an absolute magnitude (H) of 26.3, suggesting a diameter of roughly 20 m and a flyby velocity of 7.4 km/s relative to Earth. Close approaches like this are opportunities for radar observation and scientific characterization.
